# Windows ARM64 binding provenance

`src/bindings_windows_arm64.rs` was generated by the locked `whisper-rs-sys 0.13.1` build on a native Windows x64/MSVC GitHub runner and checked in after successful Windows x64 optional-ASR compilation. It is used only when Cargo's target is `aarch64-pc-windows-msvc`; all other targets retain bindgen generation. Windows x64 and ARM64 use the same 64-bit LLP64 Windows C ABI for this struct. The ARM64 build compiles the embedded size, alignment and field-offset assertions against the generated Rust layout.
